description: Define and implement unique DOM-ID ownership for whole-card and split-footer layouts. Test omitted, blank, equal, and distinct primary IDs plus navigation variants and a generated uniqueness invariant. Extend the existing CardShell private rendering helpers; no caller-specific workaround. Action reuse: local-only — DOM identity is a private presentation detail with no composable business Action contract, side effects, permissions, retries, or external consumers. Verification: focused CardShell and Channels LiveView tests, including original duplicate-ID regressions.
title: [zaq-87p.2] Enforce unique CardShell DOM IDs
